Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5260832. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5260832'. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
